summary.name: WikiArt Artworks by Style
summary.one_liner: A browsable index of art movements and styles, from Ancient Egyptian and Gothic to Impressionism and contemporary art, with artwork counts for each style on WikiArt.org.
use_cases: Researching art history periods and schools
Looking up visual style names for image prompts
Identifying the style of an artwork
summary.what_it_does: The page lists art styles grouped by era: Ancient Egyptian, Ancient Greek, Western Medieval, Western Renaissance, Western Post-Renaissance, Modern, Contemporary, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Islamic, Native and Pre-Columbian art. Each style links to its artworks and shows a count of how many works are catalogued under it. The page describes a style as the distinctive visual elements, techniques and methods of an artwork, usually tied to an art movement or school. Counts range from single digits to over 16,000 for styles such as Romanticism, Realism and Impressionism.
notable: Organised by era and region, with artwork counts per style
Covers styles from ancient Egypt to contemporary art, including Byzantine icon schools
Shows the style name and number of works in one list
caveats: The page is a list index only; it does not describe individual styles in detail
Pricing and account details are not stated on this page
